_comment: Claude Code project settings. Every hook is started through tools/hooks/run, found by $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or git's top level, never by the working directory: a relative path once made every tool call fail after one cd. A hook that cannot be found exits 1 (reported), never 2 (block). tests/test_harness.py holds this in place. 'opusplan' = the large model plans, the mid model writes.

hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || { echo "hook launcher not found; this guard did not run" >&2; exit 1; }; exec sh "$r" session_start.py

r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || { echo "hook launcher not found; this guard did not run" >&2; exit 1; }; exec sh "$r" protect_tests.py

r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/tools/hooks/run"; [ -f "$r" ] || { echo "hook launcher not found; this guard did not run" >&2; exit 1; }; exec sh "$r" stop_product_check.py
